paragraphs: R' Yehoshua ben Karchah is the well-known one; there is also Rabbi Ami bar Karchah (Bava Batra, chapter 10, halakhah 8).[^1]

notes.text: The actual Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 10:8 paragraph fully writes Rabbi Immi bar Karchah. The supplied Ami spelling and Bava Batra chapter 10 halakhah 8 are retained. The separate well-known Yehoshua pointer remains R' in the new body, without a fresh identity or common-father inference.
